scope: Read-only native continuation lineage and strategy export after delivery rebase
expected_effect: Accept proven same-task continuations without substituting the applied baseline for preregistered initial conditions; reject unrelated executions with matching IDs.
baseline: Batch pins initial native; native strategy export compares the rebased baseline with preregistered initial source.
verification: Focused controlled native-lineage counterexamples and existing normal-entry strategy export tests. No model or SDK execution.
boundaries: Reuse validate_v2_delivery_rebase for authority, actual source and resource validation. Do not change historical records or count controlled tests as autonomous success.
why: 为什么要有它：合法恢复必须保持初始比较条件及最终候选身份，不能用同名任务或重新计费冒充连续执行。
